question.text: As per SEBI regulations, which of the following is the correct frequency for issuing Consolidated Account Statements (CAS) to investors with no transactions?

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI mandates two CAS frequencies: monthly CAS for investors who have had a financial transaction during the month, and half-yearly CAS for investors whose folios have had no transactions during that period. This ensures every investor receives a periodic consolidated view of their holdings. The Trap: Candidates often confuse the no-transaction CAS frequency with the monthly cycle, or assume an annual cycle. The source ties the no-transaction CAS specifically to a half-yearly cadence. Note: Use the half-yearly CAS as a prompt to call clients for a portfolio review — it is a natural conversation starter on rebalancing or additional investments.
